info.title: API.SH: Hemmings
info.description: The Hemmings API from API.SH: public Hemmings data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Comments and bids on a Hemmings Auctions or Make Offer listing, newest first: text, whether it is a bid or offer, the commenter's site name, likes, time and replies. Classifieds have no comments. `latest=true` reads the first live auction of a search. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/hemmings-comments

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: Comments of the first current auction of a search made with the other params (default: live auctions).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

comments.text: It can be reversed if someone wanted without much trouble.

get.description:
A Hemmings dealer (name, address, city, state, ZIP, country) and its listings, with the same filters, sorts and paging as /hemmings/v1/search. Pass the dealer id from a search result or the dealer's hemmings.com/classifieds/dealer/<name> link.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/hemmings-dealer

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
How many Hemmings listings match each filter value for a search: counts by make, model (with a make), year, category, price band (US dollars), condition, transmission, country, buying format, seller type and available/sold status. Takes the same filters as /hemmings/v1/search; the facet of a filter you set shows only the selected value.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/hemmings-facets

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Model name or slug, with `make`, e.g. `mustang` (see /hemmings/v1/models).

parameters.name: variant_id
parameters.description: One or more variant (trim) ids, comma separated, with `make` and `model` (see /hemmings/v1/variants).

parameters.description: `available` (default on the site) or `sold`; comma separated for both.

parameters.name: category

parameters.name: condition
parameters.description: One or more of: mint, excellent, good, fair, project.

parameters.name: state

get.description:
One Hemmings listing by link. Classifieds: title, location, price, sold flag and price, watchers and page views, VIN, odometer, engine, body style, colours, transmission, stock number, city/state/ZIP, seller type, dealer id and inventory link, full description, all photos, videos, monthly payment estimate and the dealer's other listings. Auctions and Make Offer listings: status, asking price, current bid, bid count and bid history (amount, bidder's site name, time), minimum bid, reserve status, buyer's fee, start/end dates, views and watchers, location, specs, categories, description sections, all photos and videos. Private sellers come back with the username the site shows (`seller_name`), never contact details. `latest=true` with search filters returns the first current listing of that search. When the full auction page is briefly unavailable, the auction comes back without description, specs and photos and with `partial: true`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/hemmings-listing

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A hemmings.com listing link: /classifieds/listing/<slug> (classified) or /listing/<slug> or /auction/<slug> (auction, Make Offer).

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Instead of `url`: the listing's slug, with `kind`.

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: Return the first current listing of a search made with the other params (e.g. `make=ford&listing_type=classified`).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Classic and collector cars for sale on Hemmings: classifieds, Hemmings Auctions and Make Offer listings, with every filter of the site's search (keywords, make, model and variant, year and price range, private or dealer seller, buying format, available or sold, category, condition, transmission, country, state, ZIP radius, photos and price only, one dealer) and its sorts. Each listing: id, kind (classified, auction, make_offer), title and long title, year, make, model, VIN, stock number, price, current bid, offer count, reserve flags, status, sold date, listing/live/start/end dates, location, seller type, dealer (name and address; private sellers with the username the site shows in `seller_name`), featured/trending flags, image and link. `total` is the site's count. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/hemmings-search

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
